description: Retrospective. Protein and calorie entries against a daily target, with frequent-label chips derived from the user's own entries only (no food catalog, no fuzzy matching). nutritionTarget is append-only, one row per edit, so historical adherence stays scored against the target actually in force then. A Body screen logs weight, resting HR and sleep. Un-logged days are null, not zero, so the charts can tell "did not log" from "ate nothing".
title: Fuel and body-metric tracking
